title: Klein style LoRAs: rename the 15 weights to their display names, split 4B from 9B into their own folders, sweep R2/HF, delete the orphans
description: Fabio, 2026-08-23: the LoRA picker lists RAW FILENAMES off disk, and Klein's fifteen style weights are named nothing like the styles they produce ('cifk9001', 'PULPKHOR', 'amano_flux_02') with 4B and 9B mixed in one flat `flux2-klein/styles/` folder. Once the user picks style LoRAs by hand (see the per-phase rack card), there is no way to tell which file is which style, and no way to tell a 4B weight from a 9B one. Krea2 is NOT affected - its filenames already match its labels. Rename to the display names, split into per-size subfolders, sweep the five consumers plus R2 and HF, and garbage collect the unmanaged files on disk (Fabio spotted a THIRD Doodle in the picker; DEPS ships only two).
